objective: Sincronizador: verificar estado actual del trabajo comercial_range_batch activo después de la certificación SAFE STOP R7. Solo lectura; confirmar si ResyncLogID 483 sigue JOB_RUNNING/ESTELAR/REAL, si avanzó, terminó o cambió de estado. No modificar datos ni Producción.

queries.name: latest_comercial_range_job
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 1 ResyncLogID, Estado, Mensaje, UnidadCodigo, RegistrosAfectados, SolicitadoPor, FechaEjecucion, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.status') AS payload_status, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.current_unit') AS current_unit, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.current_block') AS current_block, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.current_phase') AS current_phase, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.percent_complete') AS percent_complete, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.updated_at_utc') AS updated_at_utc, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.successful_steps') AS successful_steps, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.failed_steps') AS failed_steps, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.completed_steps') AS completed_steps, JSON_VALUE(Payload,'$.total_steps') AS total_steps FROM dbo.Sistema_Sync_ResyncLog WHERE TipoSync='comercial_range_batch' ORDER BY ResyncLogID DESC
